title: Volume m3
description: Calculates the plan area of the farm pond from one-time length and breadth height measurements.
methodology: Multiply pond length by breadth from the one-time survey. Result is surface area in m2 used by volumetric storage and related water-level calcs.

title: Number of fillings
description: Estimates how many times the structure filled by dividing cumulative water-level rise by maximum pond depth.
methodology: Compute increase in cumulative WL height from the CM staff-gauge series. Divide by max depth of the structure (one-time height). Result is number of fillings over the monitoring period.

title: Runoff harvested (m3)
description: Estimates total water volume stored/harvested in the farm pond over the monitoring period (m3).
methodology: Compute surface area = length x breadth. Compute number of fillings from cumulative WL rise / max depth. Multiply surface area x height x number of fillings to get volumetric storage in m3.

title: Target achieved (%)
description: Tracks progress (%) of realized volumetric storage against the farm-pond volumetric water savings KPI.
methodology: Compute volumetric storage as above. Divide by the one-time target KPI for the farm pond and express as a percentage.

title: Cumulative rainfall (mm)
description: Sums reported daily rainfall over the CM monitoring period for the farm pond asset.
methodology: Sum all CM rainfall (mm) readings for the selected asset over the analysis window. Used alongside water-level charts and filling analysis.

title: Water level in farm pond (individual)
description: Time-series visualization of farm-pond water level against daily and cumulative rainfall and the pond max height.
methodology: Plot CM staff-gauge water level over date on the primary axis. Overlay daily rainfall as bars and cumulative rainfall as a stepped line on a secondary axis. Draw a horizontal dashed line at one-time pond height as the WL upper limit.
chart_description: Dual-axis chart: dark-blue line with markers for water level (m); blue bars for daily rainfall (mm); light-green stepped line for cumulative rainfall (mm); grey dashed horizontal line for max pond height / WL upper limit.

title: Average soil moisture difference (%)
description:
Average soil-moisture difference (%) between treatment and control observation points for bio-mulching / raised-bed plots.

Assumption - 40 cm root zone depth provides us a conservative estimate
variable_dependency: bm_cm_raised_bed_farming; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_a; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_b; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_c; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_d; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_centre; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_a; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_b; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_c; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_d; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_centre; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_a; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_b; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_c; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_d; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_centre
methodology: For flat plots use SM_diff (%) = average(SM_Tn - SM_Cn) across paired observation points. For raised beds compute ridge and furrow median diffs then average them: SM_diff = av(SM_r diff; SM_f diff). Control readings are paired by asset/date against treatment readings.

title: Total soil moisture water savings (m3)
description: Converts soil-moisture difference into volumetric water retained in the root zone (m3) for bio-mulching / raised-bed treatment vs control.
variable_dependency: bm_ot_area_under_the_crop; bm_ot_area_unit; bm_cm_raised_bed_farming; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_a; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_b; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_c; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_d; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_centre; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_a; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_b; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_c; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_d; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_centre; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_a; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_b; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_c; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_d; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_centre
methodology: Compute SM_diff/bigha (or acre). Convert plot area to m2. Apply fixed root-zone depth of 40 cm. SM water savings (m3) = root zone depth (40 cm) x surface area of the treated plot (m2) x sum((SM_Tn-SM_Cn)).

title: Normalized soil moisture savings (m3/acre)
description: Normalized treatment-vs-control soil-moisture savings difference (m3) by treated plot area (per bigha or acre).
variable_dependency: bm_ot_area_under_the_crop; bm_ot_area_unit; bm_cm_raised_bed_farming; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_a; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_b; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_c; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_d; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_centre; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_a; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_b; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_c; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_d; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_centre; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_a; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_b; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_c; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_d; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_centre
methodology: SM water savings (m3) / treated plot area from the one-time survey (area under the crop) using the selected area unit (acre or bigha; 1 bigha ≈ 2529 m2 where applicable).
